scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @plan-quotas/shared && npm run build --workspace @plan-quotas/server && npm run build --workspace plan-quotas-web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -b frontend
scripts.lint: eslint server shared frontend/src && prettier --check server shared frontend/src package.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write server shared frontend/src package.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:frontend && npm run build
